images.author: CDC / Cynthia Goldsmith and Jodi Black
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies extracellular HHV-8 particles grown in cell culture, showing nucleocapsids, envelopes and tegument. Grayscale fallback. This is the preview file; the page offers a 7.09 MB original, but its direct URL and pixel dimensions could not be verified.

images.author: CDC; individual creator not stated
images.why: Best colour match found: the source identifies a microscopic image of hantavirus with particles coloured green. Suitable for a particle-filled crop; species and pixel dimensions are not stated.

images.author: CDC / Cynthia Goldsmith, Luanne Elliott
images.why: Caption confirms spherical Sin Nombre virions with envelopes, surface projections and internal nucleocapsids. Grayscale fallback with a near-square composition. Preview URL; the page offers a 3.51 MB original whose direct URL could not be verified.

images.author: CDC / Cynthia Goldsmith
images.why: Caption identifies a TEM of spherical Sin Nombre virus particles, including their envelopes and nucleocapsids. Grayscale fallback. Preview URL; a 14.18 MB original is offered on the page, but its direct URL and dimensions could not be verified.

images.author: Cynthia Goldsmith; content providers: CDC / Brian W.J. Mahy, Luanne H. Elliott
images.why: Caption confirms a TEM showing the ultrastructure of spheroid Sin Nombre virions. Grayscale alternative. Preview URL; the page offers a 5.51 MB original whose direct URL and dimensions could not be verified.

images.author: CDC
images.licence: Yes - This image is copyright protected.
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies numerous spherical hepatitis E virions, approximately 32–34 nm across. Grayscale fallback requiring permission, not a verified free-use image. Preview URL; the page offers a 1.35 MB original, but its direct URL could not be verified.

images.author: Dr. Valerij Akimkin, CVUA Stuttgart
images.why: Caption confirms hepatitis E viruses from a pig, photographed by TEM at 200,000× using PTA negative staining. Grayscale scientific alternative; reuse permission and ≥1600 px resolution are not established.

images.author: National Institute of Infectious Diseases; individual image creator not stated
images.why: Figure 1 identifies actual HEV particles approximately 38 nm across, apparently aggregated by antibodies; the text locates them in infected-monkey bile. Grayscale fallback; reuse permission and ≥1600 px resolution are not established.
